_meta.warning: SEED DATA. Durations and fares are indicative. Replace with live data from a bus/rail aggregator API before launch.
_meta.note: booking_url values are plain deep links, not affiliate links. Swap in affiliate/partner URLs when you have them.

options.label: AC sleeper / seater bus (ECR or NH32)
options.frequency: Every 15-30 min from CMBT and Koyambedu; night services from 21:00
options.notes: Fastest cheap option. Dozens of operators run this route through the day and overnight — the link shows all of them, not just one. ECR route is the scenic one but slower on weekends.

options.label: Train to Puducherry station
options.frequency: Limited daily services, mostly via Villupuram
options.notes: Cheapest, but few direct trains and they sell out on weekends. Book 2+ weeks ahead.

options.label: Self-drive rental car
options.notes: Best option if you want to reach Auroville, Chunnambar and the beaches without hiring a scooter. Cost shown assumes 4 sharing. No single verified rental brand for this route — the link shows nearby rental agencies on the map.

options.label: Outstation cab / taxi
options.notes: Door to door, no driving required. Agree the fare (or use an app's estimate) before you set off. Cost shown assumes 4 sharing.

options.label: Overnight AC sleeper
options.notes: Overnight both ways is how most weekenders do it - you lose no daylight. Many operators run this route — the link shows all of them.

options.label: Self-drive rental car
options.notes: 6-7 hours via Krishnagiri-Tiruvannamalai, longer on Friday evenings.

options.label: Outstation cab / taxi
options.notes: 6-7 hours via Krishnagiri-Tiruvannamalai. Agree the fare before you set off.

options.label: Overnight bus via Salem
options.notes: Long haul. Consider flying to Chennai and taking a cab instead.

options.label: Fly to Chennai, then road transfer
options.notes: Includes roughly 3 hours road from Chennai airport. Puducherry's own airport has very limited service.

options.label: Train to Villupuram, then local bus
options.notes: Villupuram is 40 km out; frequent buses and shared cabs from there.

options.label: Own arrangement
options.notes: Arrival and departure times taken as given.

local_transport.label: Scooter rental
local_transport.notes: How almost everyone gets around. Licence and ID required. Needed for Auroville, Chunnambar and Serenity - the autos add up fast. No single verified rental shop — the link shows nearby options on the map.

local_transport.label: Auto rickshaw
local_transport.notes: Fine inside town, expensive for Auroville and Paradise Beach runs. Agree the fare first. Usually hailed in person rather than booked — the link shows nearby stands.

local_transport.label: Bicycle rental
local_transport.notes: Perfect for White Town, useless beyond it.
